name: Acid Mist
source: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
description: A golden guardrail sprays magical, flesh-eating acid throughout the stairwell.
disable: DC 26 Thievery check (expert) to deactivate the trap's sensors, or DC 24 Arcana check (expert) to disrupt the guardrail's magic, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 24) to counteract the guardrail
reset: The trap automatically deactivates after 1 minute. It resets in 1 hour.
routine: (1 action) On its initiative, the trap continues to spray acid, dealing 2d8+9 acid damage to all living creatures on the stairs (DC 25 basic Reflex save).

offensiveAbilities.name: Spray Acid
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature steps on the south stairs

Effect The guardrail sprays flesh-eating acid, filling the entire stairwell. All living creatures on the stairs area take 2d8+9 acid damage (DC 27 basic Reflex save). The trap then rolls initiative.
